facts.text: Everybody deserves one good night. Dinner first, then we push the table back and dance. Even this town.
facts.why: No quote page opened has this line, and in the film the dance is not at the town hall. The prom is held in a grain mill just over the county line, out of Bomont's reach. It reads as an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: Dinner first. Then we take the party to the grain mill, just over the county line, where nobody can stop us.

fix_note.text: Dinner first. Then we take the party to the grain mill, just over the county line, where nobody can stop us.

facts.why: Wikipedia's plot and the transcript have church services and the Reverend's sermons but no church social. The film's big event is the senior prom, so the note points there.
No church social appears in Wikipedia's plot or the transcript. The senior prom is real, and the popcorn balls are still caramel popcorn balls under the new name.

vibe.verdict: A good prom night frame with an 80s look, but the food only touches a few scenes and the note misplaces the dance.
